name: Tetrahedral Mesh Connectivity Encoding
definition: A method to encode the connectivity of a tetrahedral mesh segment using opcodes that describe the position of new vertices relative to a growing region bounded by a cut-border, ensuring unique identification of vertices across multi-resolution segments.
summary: Tetrahedral Mesh Connectivity Encoding compresses mesh topology via region-growing traversal and 11 opcodes, distinguishing itself by using a dynamic cut-border boundary instead of static grid indices.
